title: Template:Navbox/doc
content:
;Description :This template is used to create a basic [[Help:Navbox|navbox]]. ;Syntax :Type {{t|navbox|...}} somewhere, with parameters as shown below. ;Sample output 
{{navbox
|header=Land of Bob
|body=This [[place]] and that [[place]].
}}
Results in... {{navbox |header=Land of Bob |body=This [[place]] and that [[place]]. }} [[Category:General wiki templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
